_doc: Route line colours and widths. The app reads this file and draws the route at run time (line layers above roads, below labels).
The owner chose candidate B ('Clear') on 2026-11-15: 'selected' names it and the app draws it. A and C are kept for reference. Renders: assets/sheet/index.html and data/art/route/*.png.

Each theme: fill (the line) and casing (a wider line drawn under it). traveled: the part already driven, the candidate mixed 55 % toward the map's land colour (day #E2DFDA, night #1F1F1F). alternative: the other route choices while choosing, grey; a tap on one chooses it (0.1.40, play test P23). trip_route: the trip's own route drawn under a previewed stop's route (item 51, 0.1.40), the same grey. The traveled part and the alternatives never show together (no route choices while guided); the traveled part and trip_route neither (a stop preview's own route has no driven part).

Widths in dp per map zoom, to be interpolated exponentially with base 1.5 (MapLibre: ["interpolate", ["exponential", 1.5], ["zoom"], z1, w1, ...]). The casing is drawn as its own wider line, not as a line-gap.
Colours as #RRGGBB, opaque. Line cap and join round.

A.name: Sky
A.note: the blue of the approved marker sketch; the lightest of the three and the closest to the day water colour

B.name: Clear
B.note: deeper and more saturated, by day and by night: the darkest of the three, not the lightest; the strongest edge on the day map and, by day, the furthest from water

C.name: Periwinkle
C.note: softer and slightly violet; the brightest line at night

layer_order: above the road and bridge layers, below one-way arrows, shields and all labels (in the bundled style: right before 'roads_oneway')
